latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pinterest-ads-cli, a CLI tool for Pinterest Ads data analysis and reporting.

- Query ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, customer lists, and conversion tags.
- Analyze billing profiles and review product catalogs, feeds, and product groups.
- Access trending Pinterest search terms and analytics with attribution windows.
- All commands output JSON; supports pagination and sorting.
- Requires configuration of a Pinterest OAuth2 access token with appropriate scopes.
- Read-only access; supports inspection, reporting, and analytics (no write features).
